component.name: Ishtaria
component.summary: Client for the Ishtaria federated virtual planet

description.p: Ishtaria is a federated virtual world in which every server hosts its own planet. This is the 3D client: it connects to a server, creates your character and lets you walk, gather resources and meet the people of the world.
The server owns all game state; the client only sends your intentions. English and Czech are supported.
